name: Excited-state Opt S1 (PBE0)
template:
# Excited-state (S1) geometry optimisation — the first step toward fluorescence /
# adiabatic (0-0) energies: relax the geometry ON the first excited state (iroot 1).
# Follow with an excited-state Freq at this geometry (confirm a min + ZPE), then a
# vertical TD-DFT single point here gives the emission energy. Use this recipe in an
# Optimize node (it outputs the relaxed S1 geometry).

! PBE0 def2-SVP RIJCOSX def2/J Opt

%maxcore 3000

%pal nprocs 8
end

%tddft
  nroots 5
  iroot 1
end
